necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under reason code PR-204, yet the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation associated with diagnosis code I48.0. Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in the setting of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, as indicated by diagnosis code Z86.73.
